normalization: Midrank empirical percentiles fitted on evaluable components of unmodified TRAIN slides only; no calibration, annotation, injection truth, donor IDs or absolute coordinates.
threshold_rule: Strictly exceed the higher empirical quantile of per-slide maximum rank scores on unmodified training slides; include reject-all. Exact tied scores crossing the review cap are abstained as a group, never broken using location or metadata.
selection: For each fixed strategy, choose one training candidate satisfying burden and harm, maximizing fragment recall then recovery, then minimizing genuine-cancer flags, review burden and cap; ties favor higher thresholds. Choose primary strategy by the same TRAIN-only ordering. Report all selected points and unbudgeted top-one diagnostics. Never retune on known calibration results.
calibration_role: Iterative development; prior calibration outcomes are already known. It is not independent validation.
